prologue.text:
[VIDEO MESSAGE: 00:13 sec — Sent from Halima’s device]
[Grainy, low light. Halima’s face appears briefly—tired, bruised, whispering.]

“Viewer… I don’t know if you’re still watching. I’m somewhere I shouldn’t be.”
“The trail was clean—too clean. That kind of clean doesn’t happen unless someone wants to be found.”
“I followed it anyway. I had to. The contract wasn’t even about the bounty anymore.”

[A flicker behind her. Something fast. Eyes shine faintly red. She turns, then—static.]

[TEXT MESSAGE — Halima’s Device]
Incoming Message from: Unknown Contact

MURNA:
yo Viewer...
this Halima's line right?
look i know this is weird but... she gone.

not ghosted gone
not “i’ll be back in 5” gone
gone gone.

who_is_this.text:
MURNA:

chill. it’s Murna.
class clown. spiritual dropout. carries a butter-knife katana and a few shiny rings. remember me now?

i jacked her phone after the trail ran cold. she woulda wanted you in.
you’re that Righteous sightseer type, right?
maybe you can see what i can't.

gone_explained.text:
MURNA:

she's gone.
like erased.

bounty job she picked up got real weird.
name wiped from the Nexus network.
no aura trails. no surveillance threads.
it’s like she un-existed.

last ping we got was a warehouse near the Yelwa border.
smelled off.
like... copper and sugar.
found these weird skin flakes and chains. she was fighting something that didn't bleed right.

last_seen.text:
MURNA:

last ping we got was a warehouse near the Yelwa border.
smelled off.
like... copper and sugar.
found these weird skin flakes and chains. she was fighting something that didn't bleed right.

chat_continuation.text:
MURNA:

look… she’s really gone.
but before she vanished, she dropped your name.
not like a “help me” kind of drop.
more like… “if anything happens to me, you find the viewer.”
and now here i am.

chat_continuation2.text:
MURNA:

oh right
forgot we never chopped it up before.
but i know of you.
and i figured you knew of me too.

chat_continuation3.text:
MURNA:

called in a favor.
had Kelvin look you up.

you know how he is.
digital messiah with a God-complex and bad sleep habits.
said you and him “already go back.”
his words. not mine.

so i figured… if he already trusts you, and Halima trusted you…
then you’re in. even if we don’t share playlists yet.

[You think to yourself: Kelvin. Of course. If anyone would’ve had my number memorized in three dimensions and archived in seven databases, it’d be him. We haven’t spoken in a while. But he never forgets anything. Or anyone.]

what_happened.text:
MURNA:

She left this on her voice recorder:

“they don’t like sunlight. Or prayers. Or names.”

what kinda bounty says that?

suspect_pitch.text:
MURNA:

Pitch? ...yea maybe. But I don't trust that guy.
He was the last one who argued with Halima before she disappeared.

warehouse_search.text: The warehouse is cold and empty. Chains are scattered on the floor. You notice scorch marks and symbols you don't recognize. It feels like someone was restrained here... and taken.

confront_pitch.text:
Pitch glares when accused. Murna pushes him harder, and his hand goes to his blade.

Pitch: 'Say that again, and see what happens.'

pitch_kills_murna.text:
Pitch snaps. Shadows coil around Murna's throat, lifting him into the air. He slams Murna down with lethal force. You watch in horror as the life fades from your friend's eyes.

This path ends in tragedy.

murna_update.text:
MURNA:

Whatever took her left in a hurry. Kelvin might know more. He’s been tracking Red Veil movements.

kelvin_intro.text:
Kelvin's workshop is cluttered with drones and screens. He adjusts his glasses as you fill him in.

Kelvin: 'Yelwa border, chains, no aura traces? That's Red Veil protocol. But why would they want Halima?'

red_veil_info.text: Kelvin: 'They're a network of vampiric elites. They operate in shadows, trade in aura-rich bloodlines... and when someone disappears, it usually ends with an auction.'

plan_next_move.text: You and the team prepare. The trail leads to something bigger—the Red Veil’s black tie masquerade auction.

auction_intro.text:
You gather your gear and move toward the masquerade. The night hums with danger.

Somewhere inside, Halima is waiting.
